Need verify letter written first half 20th century, from ruler of one country to another, delivered by an official nicknamed after body part by recipient.

C1 says transmitted under cover of memorandum from Donovan. C2 handed to OSS officer. But no body part nickname. So partial.

R2: "It was written roughly six months after the author had come to power." Do claims establish King Michael came to power? King Michael first reign? 1927-1930, second 1940-1947. In 1945, not six months after came to power? Actually in 1944 coup? Hmm no outside. Claims do not mention author coming to power nor timing. C1 date March 5 1945 but no accession date. C3 letter content. None. Unsupported.

R3: "In it, the author refers to their country having regained a region." C3 directly: In letter, King Michael refers to Romania having regained North Transylvania. Fully supported.

R4: "What is the name of the region referred to?" This is the question requirement: need name of region. C3 provides North Transylvania. Does that fully support? The requirement asks name. Need output exactly. For R4, supported_by C3.

R2 unsupported with empty.

Potential issue: R1 has "delivered by an official who was nicknamed after a body part by its recipient." The recipient is President? Official maybe OSS officer? Was Frank Wisner? Nicknamed "the man with the wooden leg"? no. But claims don't mention. So partial.
